invariant: The client verifies its configured issuer connection, correlates replies, and never replays an uncertain exchange.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Complete P00-P10 baseline and unchanged acceptance lock
Production issuer enrollment, authentication, and revocation
Direct cross-host connection through the production client
limitations: Envelope validation does not replace semantic identity and authorization checks.
Authenticated world entry, current authority checks, and immediate live revocation remain required.
Nonempty bootstrap profiles and scoped grants remain required.
